title: NPC SecAct open-data analysis
description: Reproducibility package for a patient-level multimodal analysis of treatment-associated inferred secreted-protein activity in nasopharyngeal carcinoma. The release contains analysis code, frozen protocols, de-identified patient/specimen-level derived results, source-data audits, exact environment snapshots, hashes, and vector figures. It does not establish measured protein secretion, a proven cellular source, treatment causality, SecAct superiority, or a validated clinical predictor.
